name: spec-cycle-lens
description: Read-only lens over a spec-cycle project: the active work item and gate verdict above the prompt, a /lens pane of work items and runs, and the next spec-cycle command suggested (never submitted).

band.title: Band
band.description: Draw the one-line band above the prompt.

suggest.title: Suggest next command
suggest.description: Propose the next spec-cycle command in the prompt box (Tab to take). Never submits.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Glyph set for the band and the pane.

snapshotPath.title: Snapshot path
snapshotPath.description: Where spec-cycle writes status.json, relative to the project; config.yaml is expected beside it.
